working_definition: Author type 'T2/T2a/T3 neuron' (L3_55, lobula plate class) of the Konstantinides et al. 2022 wandering L3 larval optic lobe atlas: IPC-derived T2/T2a/T3 neurons, unresolved.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T neuron (Hormann et al., 2020).

justification: Grouped call (T2, T2a, T3): the most specific immature common parent is immature T neuron, as used for the Ozel 2021 and Kurmangaliyev 2020 immature T2/T2a/T3. FBbt #2216 requests immature T2/T2a/T3 terms; for this unsplit cluster their common parent would still be immature T neuron, so the mapping does not wait on it. Mature members listed as candidates.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T neuron with its soma posteriorly adjacent to the gap between the medulla and lobula plate and a cell body fiber that projects along the proximal surface of the medulla before branching in the second optic chiasm (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Shinomiya et al., 2019). One branch projects into a medulla column, where it forms a bushy, fine, arborization in medulla layer M9 and then projects through the rest of the medulla column, forming fine arborizations in M1, M2 and M5. The other branch forms a terminal arborization in lobula layer 3 that is much wider than a single column and has bleb-type terminal branches. It seems to be capable of cholinergic and GABAergic neurotransmission.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form; larval cells are immature.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T neuron with its soma posteriorly adjacent to the gap between the medulla and lobula plate and a cell body fiber that projects along the proximal surface of the medulla before branching in the second optic chiasm (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Shinomiya et al., 2019). One branch projects into a medulla column, where it forms a bushy, fine, arborization in medulla layer M9 and then projects through the rest of the medulla column, bifurcating in medulla layer M5 and forming fine arbors throughout layers M1-4. The other branch forms a terminal arborization in lobula layer 3 that is much wider than a single column and has bleb-type terminal branches.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T neuron with its soma posteriorly adjacent to the gap between the medulla and lobula plate and a cell body fiber that projects along the proximal surface of the medulla before branching in the second optic chiasm (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Shinomiya et al., 2019). One branch forms a bushy, fine, terminal arborization in medulla layer M9 and the other forms a terminal arborization in lobula layers 2 and 3 with mix of bleb-type and fine terminal branches (Morante and Desplan, 2008; Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It seems to be capable of both glutamatergic and GABAergic neurotransmission.
